title: RadioSonde Track Weekly Ascent Rate Trend
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radiosonde:track ascent_rate_m_s=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(ascent_rate_m_s) as avg_duration, max(ascent_rate_m_s) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst ascent rate for RadioSonde track events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture ascent_rate_m_s on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average ascent rate with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It catches whether RadioSonde track tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
